answer: A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The prism counter is kept in quill and orchard reveals each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
